notes.title: Massive thanks! ONE HUNDRED COPIES SOLD!
notes.content:
Dear players and community,

I am absolutely thrilled to announce that Feed Him, my first-ever indie game, has sold over 100 copies on Steam! This achievement is a dream come true for me, and I couldn't have done it without your support!

Creating Feed Him was a journey that I will never forget. From the initial idea to the final product, every step of the process was challenging and rewarding. I poured my heart and soul into this game, and it fills me with joy to see that players are enjoying it as much as I enjoyed creating it.

I would like to take this opportunity to express my deepest gratitude to each and every one of you who has supported me on this journey. Your feedback and reviews mean the world to me, and I am committed to continuing to improve and create unique and exciting games.

If you haven't had a chance to check out Feed Him yet, I invite you to do so. As a first-time indie developer, your support means everything to me. And if you have already played the game, I would be honored if you could leave a review on Steam.

Thank you again for your support and for making my dream a reality. I can't wait to see what the future holds for me as an indie developer.

Sincerely,
ThatDRW
